sections.heading: Linear Algebra
formulas: Sum of eigenvalues = trace(A); product of eigenvalues = det(A)
Eigenvalues of A^k are lambda^k; of A^-1 are 1/lambda; of A + kI are lambda + k
Rank(A) = number of non-zero rows in echelon form; Ax = b consistent iff rank(A) = rank([A|b])
Cayley-Hamilton: every square matrix satisfies its own characteristic equation

sections.heading: Calculus
formulas: Integral of sin^n x from 0 to pi/2 (Wallis): ((n-1)/n)((n-3)/(n-2))... x (pi/2 if n even, 1 if n odd)
Maxima/minima of f(x, y): rt - s^2 > 0 and r < 0 -> maximum; r > 0 -> minimum; rt - s^2 < 0 -> saddle
Taylor: f(x) = sum f^(n)(a)(x - a)^n / n!

sections.heading: Complex Variables
formulas: Cauchy-Riemann: u_x = v_y, u_y = -v_x
Residue at simple pole z0: lim (z - z0) f(z); at pole of order m: (1/(m-1)!) d^(m-1)/dz^(m-1) [(z - z0)^m f(z)]
Contour integral = 2 pi j x (sum of residues inside)

sections.heading: Probability
formulas: Bayes: P(A|B) = P(B|A) P(A) / P(B)
Binomial: mean np, variance np(1 - p); Poisson: mean = variance = lambda
Exponential(lambda): mean 1/lambda, variance 1/lambda^2; Uniform(a, b): mean (a + b)/2, variance (b - a)^2/12
Normal: about 68% / 95% / 99.7% within 1 / 2 / 3 sigma

sections.heading: Numerical Methods
formulas: Newton-Raphson: x(n+1) = x(n) - f(x(n))/f'(x(n))
Trapezoidal: (h/2)[y0 + 2(y1 + ... + y(n-1)) + yn]; Simpson 1/3: (h/3)[y0 + 4(odd) + 2(even) + yn]

sections.heading: Theorems
formulas: Maximum power transfer (resistive): RL = Rth, Pmax = Vth^2/(4 Rth)
AC maximum power: ZL = Zth* (conjugate); if only |ZL| variable: |ZL| = |Zth|
Star-delta: R_star = (Ra Rb)/(Ra + Rb + Rc); R_delta = (R1R2 + R2R3 + R3R1)/R_opposite

sections.heading: Transients
formulas: x(t) = x(inf) + [x(0+) - x(inf)] e^(-t/tau); tau = RC or L/R
Series RLC: alpha = R/(2L), w0 = 1/sqrt(LC); overdamped if alpha > w0
Capacitor voltage and inductor current cannot change instantaneously

sections.heading: AC and Three-Phase
formulas: S = V I* = P + jQ; pf = P/|S|
Resonance: f0 = 1/(2 pi sqrt(LC)); Q (series) = w0 L/R; bandwidth = f0/Q
Star: V_L = sqrt(3) V_ph, I_L = I_ph; Delta: V_L = V_ph, I_L = sqrt(3) I_ph; P = sqrt(3) V_L I_L cos(phi)
Two-wattmeter: P = W1 + W2; tan(phi) = sqrt(3)(W1 - W2)/(W1 + W2)

sections.heading: Two-Port
formulas: Reciprocal: z12 = z21, y12 = y21, AD - BC = 1, h12 = -h21
Symmetric: z11 = z22, A = D

sections.heading: Electrostatics
formulas: Coulomb: F = Q1Q2/(4 pi eps r^2); E (point charge) = Q/(4 pi eps r^2)
Infinite line charge: E = rho_L/(2 pi eps r); infinite sheet: E = rho_s/(2 eps)
Gauss: closed-surface integral of D.dS = Q_enclosed; div D = rho_v
Parallel plate: C = eps A/d; coaxial: C = 2 pi eps L/ln(b/a); isolated sphere: C = 4 pi eps a
Energy: W = (1/2) C V^2 = (1/2) integral of eps E^2 dv

sections.heading: Magnetostatics
formulas: Biot-Savart: dH = I dl x a_R/(4 pi R^2); infinite wire: H = I/(2 pi r)
Ampere: closed-loop integral of H.dl = I_enclosed; curl H = J
Faraday: emf = -N d(phi)/dt; Lorentz: F = q(E + v x B)
Reluctance S = l/(mu A); mmf = N I = phi x S_total; L = N^2/S
Coaxial cable inductance per metre: (mu/2 pi) ln(b/a)

sections.heading: Transforms
formulas: a^n u[n] <-> z/(z - a), ROC |z| > |a|
Final value: lim t->inf x(t) = lim s->0 sX(s) (poles of sX(s) in LHP)
Parseval: integral |x(t)|^2 dt = (1/2 pi) integral |X(w)|^2 dw
Time shift: x(t - t0) <-> e^(-jw t0) X(w); scaling: x(at) <-> (1/|a|) X(w/a)

sections.heading: Sampling and LTI
formulas: Nyquist rate = 2 f_max; alias of f with fs: |f - k fs|
BIBO stable iff integral |h(t)| dt < inf; causal iff h(t) = 0 for t < 0
Convolution: y(t) = integral x(tau) h(t - tau) d tau; width of result = sum of widths

sections.heading: Transformers
formulas: E = 4.44 f N phi_m
Max efficiency at load fraction x = sqrt(P_core/P_cu,FL)
Regulation (lagging) ~ (I R cos phi + I X sin phi)/V x 100%
All-day efficiency = output energy / input energy over 24 h
Auto-transformer copper saving = (1 - V2/V1) x copper of 2-winding transformer

sections.heading: DC Machines
formulas: E = P phi Z N/(60 A); T = P phi Z Ia/(2 pi A)
Motor: V = Eb + Ia Ra; N proportional to Eb/phi
Series motor: T proportional to Ia^2 (unsaturated)

sections.heading: Induction Machines
formulas: Ns = 120 f/P; s = (Ns - N)/Ns; rotor frequency = s f
Air-gap power : rotor copper loss : mechanical power = 1 : s : (1 - s)
Slip at Tmax: s_m = R2/X2; Tmax independent of R2
T_start/T_max = 2 s_m/(1 + s_m^2); T/T_max = 2/(s/s_m + s_m/s)
Star-delta starter: starting current and torque reduced to 1/3

sections.heading: Synchronous Machines
formulas: E = V + j Xs I (generator); P = (E V/Xs) sin(delta)
Salient pole: P = (E V/Xd) sin(delta) + (V^2/2)(1/Xq - 1/Xd) sin(2 delta)
Over-excited motor: leading pf, supplies Q; V-curve minimum armature current at unity pf

sections.heading: Per Unit and Lines
formulas: Z_new = Z_old (S_new/S_old)(V_old/V_new)^2
Z_base = V_base^2/S_base
Nominal-pi: A = D = 1 + YZ/2, B = Z, C = Y(1 + YZ/4)
Surge impedance Zc = sqrt(L/C); SIL = V^2/Zc
Receiving-end power: P = (Vs Vr/X) sin(delta) for a lossless line

sections.heading: Faults
formulas: 3-phase: If = E/Z1
LG: If = 3E/(Z1 + Z2 + Z0 + 3Zf)
LL: If = sqrt(3) E/(Z1 + Z2)
LLG: Ia1 = E/(Z1 + Z2 || (Z0 + 3Zf))
Symmetrical components: a = 1 angle 120 deg; Va0 = (Va + Vb + Vc)/3

sections.heading: Stability and Dispatch
formulas: Swing: (2H/ws) d^2 delta/dt^2 = Pm - Pe
Critical clearing (fault Pe = 0): cos(delta_c) = (Pm/Pmax)(delta_max - delta0) + cos(delta_max), angles in radians
Economic dispatch: dC1/dP1 = dC2/dP2 = lambda (losses neglected)
With losses: (dCi/dPi) x Li = lambda, Li = 1/(1 - dPL/dPi)

sections.heading: Cables and Insulators
formulas: Cable capacitance per metre: 2 pi eps/ln(R/r); max stress at the conductor
String efficiency = V_string/(n x V_unit nearest line)

sections.heading: Time Response
formulas: Second order: s^2 + 2 zeta wn s + wn^2
Peak overshoot Mp = e^(-pi zeta/sqrt(1 - zeta^2)); tp = pi/wd; wd = wn sqrt(1 - zeta^2)
Settling time (2%) = 4/(zeta wn); rise time = (pi - theta)/wd, theta = acos(zeta)
Kp = lim G(s), Kv = lim s G(s), Ka = lim s^2 G(s) as s -> 0
ess (step) = 1/(1 + Kp); (ramp) = 1/Kv; (parabola) = 1/Ka

sections.heading: Stability
formulas: Routh: number of sign changes in first column = RHP poles
Root locus: centroid = (sum poles - sum zeros)/(P - Z); asymptote angles = (2k + 1)180/(P - Z)
Nyquist: Z = P - N (N counter-clockwise encirclements of -1)
GM = 1/|G(j w_pc)|; PM = 180 + angle G(j w_gc)

sections.heading: Compensators and State Space
formulas: Lead: (1 + aTs)/(1 + Ts), a > 1; max phase sin(phi_m) = (a - 1)/(a + 1) at w = 1/(T sqrt(a))
Transfer function: G(s) = C(sI - A)^-1 B + D
Controllable iff rank[B AB ... A^(n-1)B] = n; observable iff rank[C; CA; ...] = n
State transition matrix: phi(t) = L^-1[(sI - A)^-1]

sections.heading: Instruments
formulas: Ammeter shunt: Rsh = Rm Im/(I - Im); voltmeter multiplier: Rs = V/Im - Rm
PMMC: deflection proportional to average current; MI: proportional to I^2 (reads RMS)
Energy meter error = (registered - true)/true x 100%

sections.heading: Bridges
formulas: Wheatstone balance: R1 R4 = R2 R3
Maxwell inductance-capacitance: Lx = R2 R3 C1, Rx = R2 R3/R1
Schering: Cx = C2 R4/R3, tan(delta) = w C4 R4

sections.heading: Errors and CRO
formulas: For x = a^m b^n: limiting error % = |m| (da/a) + |n| (db/b)
Lissajous: fy/fx = horizontal tangencies/vertical tangencies; phase sin(phi) = y-intercept/y-max

sections.heading: Analog
formulas: Half-wave: Vdc = Vm/pi, ripple factor 1.21; full-wave: Vdc = 2Vm/pi, ripple factor 0.48
Inverting amp gain = -Rf/R1; non-inverting = 1 + Rf/R1
Schmitt trigger thresholds = +/- Vsat R1/(R1 + R2)
BJT: gm = Ic/VT, r_pi = beta/gm; MOSFET saturation: Id = (k/2)(Vgs - Vt)^2
Wien bridge oscillator: f = 1/(2 pi RC), gain needed 3; RC phase shift: f = 1/(2 pi RC sqrt(6)), gain 29

sections.heading: Digital
formulas: De Morgan: (AB)' = A' + B'; (A + B)' = A'B'
Mod-N counter needs ceil(log2 N) flip-flops
n-bit DAC resolution = Vref/(2^n - 1); ADC quantisation step = Vref/2^n

sections.heading: DC-DC
formulas: Buck: Vo = D Vin; ripple dI = (Vin - Vo) D/(L f)
Boost: Vo = Vin/(1 - D); buck-boost: Vo = -D Vin/(1 - D)
CCM boundary (buck): Io = dI/2

sections.heading: Rectifiers
formulas: 1-phase full converter (continuous): Vo = (2Vm/pi) cos(alpha)
1-phase semi-converter: Vo = (Vm/pi)(1 + cos(alpha))
3-phase full converter: Vo = (3 Vml/pi) cos(alpha), Vml = peak line voltage
Input pf (1-phase full, ripple-free current) = (2 sqrt(2)/pi) cos(alpha) = 0.9 cos(alpha)

sections.heading: Inverters and Drives
formulas: 1-phase full-bridge square wave: V1(rms) = 0.9 Vdc; nth harmonic = V1/n (odd n)
3-phase 180-degree: V_L(rms) = 0.816 Vdc, V_ph(rms) = 0.471 Vdc
SPWM (linear): V1(peak, phase) = m Vdc/2
V/f control keeps the air-gap flux constant

sections.heading: Quantitative
formulas: Work: combined rate = sum of individual rates (subtract outlets)
Successive percentage change a% then b%: a + b + ab/100
nPr = n!/(n - r)!, nCr = n!/(r!(n - r)!)
Simple interest PNR/100; compound amount P(1 + r/100)^n
